title: Caliban's War
author: James S. A. Corey
summary: The second Expanse novel, in a solar system where Earth, Mars and the Belt are on the edge of open war. A crisis on a Jovian moon pulls in the crew of a ship led by a stubborn captain, plus a marine and a veteran politician.
readIf: you like grounded, fast space opera with political tension and a strong ensemble.
skipIf: you haven't read the first book, which sets up the crew and the central conflict.

pairings.reason: The first book in the same series, if you want to start with the ensemble and setup this one builds on.
Also mixes interplanetary class conflict with intense action and large stakes, though more stylised.
A friendlier, more hands-on take on survival in a hostile solar system, driven by science.
